$comment: Developer-only synthetic Skills for the evolution Step 18 routing, collision and context benchmark. They are never added to the production package: run-routing-context.mjs builds each scenario in a disposable copy outside the repository. Groups: distinct (unrelated scopes), adjacent (similar terminology to one production Skill), overlap (valid but overlapping task boundaries), conflict (deliberately conflicting descriptions). Two names contain digits on purpose (a11y, k6): the Skill name rule allows them, and the transcript parsers must detect them.

scenarios.description: The shipped package alone; the reference point for metadata and regressions.
Eight Skills with unrelated scopes added to the shipped package.
SC1 plus six Skills whose terminology is close to one production Skill each.
SC2 plus four Skills with valid but overlapping task boundaries: 18 valid synthetic Skills, 34 in total.
SC1 plus a paraphrased duplicate of the production testing Skill. It is valid by every static check, so only routing evidence can reveal the collision.
SC1 plus the GraphQL Skill and two near-copies. The distinctness check must reject exactly the two copied pairs; the scenario is never installed.
